summary: CliRunner.invoke raises ValueError after a command uses echo_via_pager.
issue_text: When echo_via_pager is used in a Click command, CliRunner.invoke fails with ValueError: I/O operation on closed file. The reporter says this occurs with Click 8.4 and does not occur with 8.3.3. The reproducer defines a command that calls echo_via_pager("Hello, Click!") and invokes it with CliRunner().
traceback_excerpt: click/testing.py, in invoke: sys.stdout.flush(); ValueError: I/O operation on closed file.
dependency_note: Click's runtime package is pure Python and has no third-party runtime dependencies; pytest is supplied by the pinned ReproForge worker image.
